text: {"features":[{"name":"Security motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why the applicant wants to do security engineering work rather than generic software work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only routine interest in the opening, with little personal reason for wanting security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses a general desire for security impact or rigor, but the rationale stays broad and interchangeable with many software roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear, role-relevant reason for pursuing security engineering, such as preventive impact or higher standards."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects a thoughtful security motivation to past experiences or personal values in a way that materially strengthens fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a distinctive and deeply convincing security motivation that feels central to the applicant's career direction."}]},{"name":"Role alignment","description":"How precisely the letter maps the applicant's background to the posted responsibilities and qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions the role but connects the applicant's background to only a small portion of the posted work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Addresses a few relevant requirements, yet leaves several important duties or preferred skills unaddressed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Matches the letter to several core duties and required skills with reasonably direct connections."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly maps experience to most named responsibilities and preferred skills in the posting."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Gives a precise and comprehensive fit narrative spanning Go backends, Python or agent work, vulnerability handling, security assessment, and developer support."}]},{"name":"Security automation mindset","description":"How well the letter frames security work as a scalable systems problem instead of isolated manual tasks or compliance activity.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the opening mainly as general software engineering, with little sense of security automation as a systems problem."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security and automation, but not in a way that clearly shows how automation scales security work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a basic understanding that automation can reduce manual security toil or triage load."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames security challenges as workflow and systems problems involving scalable triage, lifecycle integration, or auditable processes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a sophisticated view of security automation as capacity multiplication through structured triage, variant analysis, secure defaults, or bounded tooling."}]},{"name":"Platform orientation","description":"How clearly the letter shows motivation for central infrastructure work whose impact compounds across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little indication that central infrastructure or organization-wide leverage is part of the role's appeal."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or impact in generic terms without explaining why foundational work matters."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses clear interest in platform or infrastructure work whose benefits extend beyond a single product."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how central tooling can compound value across many teams and ties that idea to the role's appeal."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage a core theme, showing a strong personal draw toward foundational systems with broad downstream effect."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How strongly the letter focuses on making security easier and more effective for developer teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little or nothing about helping developer teams adopt secure behavior through better tools or defaults."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in improving security, but not specifically in enabling developers."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Notes the value of reducing manual work or making secure choices easier for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames security tooling as developer-facing infrastructure that removes friction and shapes better defaults."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly centers busy developers as users of the system and explains how automation or defaults improve their everyday practice."}]},{"name":"Security partnership","description":"How clearly the letter shows readiness to work closely with specialized security engineers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says nothing specific about partnering with security specialists or supporting their workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic teamwork language, but not in a way that is specific to collaboration with a security function."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in working alongside security engineers or learning from them."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames the role as a close partnership with specialized security practitioners and shows respect for their expertise or needs."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong readiness for ongoing security partnership through prior cross-functional examples, explicit service to security workflows, or a detailed view of how joint work should function."}]},{"name":"Experience depth","description":"Depth of career experience relevant to the role, reflected in duration, progression, and maturity of responsibility.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents early-career experience that meets the baseline but shows limited progression or senior responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows relevant experience with steady production work, but only modest evidence of growing scope or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Conveys solid mid-level experience with clear responsibility for building and maintaining production software."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial experience with visible progression into design, ownership, or operational leadership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents mature, immediately relevant experience with clear progression and strong readiness for this kind of security tooling role."}]},{"name":"Production scope","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant has built, launched, or maintained production systems of meaningful scope or criticality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"References a small number of production services or systems, with little indication of complexity, criticality, or reach."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows production exposure across a few services, but the scope or impact of those systems remains limited."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Demonstrates meaningful production responsibility across several services or internal tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows work on important or high-throughput systems, or on tools used across teams, with clear operational relevance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents strong evidence of owning or materially shaping critical, broadly used, or technically demanding production systems."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"Strength and relevance of the letter's evidence about using Go to build backend or infrastructure systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Names Go as a language used, but gives almost no detail about using it in relevant backend work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some production experience in Go, yet without clear signs of deep ownership or strong relevance to this role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a primary or regular language for production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties Go experience to designing or operating backend infrastructure that resembles this role's responsibilities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to sustained ownership of backend or control-plane systems, especially where it constrains or supports security tooling."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Strength and relevance of the letter's evidence about using Python for services, tooling, or automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of Python use relevant to the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python lightly for scripts or incidental tooling, with limited scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong Python ownership through production services, internal tooling, or deliberately engineered code."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Python a major strength tied directly to automation layers, analysis tooling, or agent behavior that others rely on."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Depth of hands-on experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of automating vulnerability intake, triage, or related response work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security tooling or reducing toil in general, but not concrete vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant automated vulnerability intake or triage at a high level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage behaviors such as classification, routing, prioritization, deduplication, or self-serve handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of vulnerability-handling automation with clear process impact, such as expert time returned, measurable throughput gains, or broad operational reliance."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"Depth of hands-on experience assessing systems for security issues and carrying findings through to remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of having assessed systems for security issues."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest through adjacent activities, but gives little direct assessment experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant has performed security assessments or reviews in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Specifies concrete assessment practices such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or remediation validation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys repeated, substantive assessment work with an attacker mindset and clear follow-through into fixes or release decisions."}]},{"name":"Agentic design","description":"Depth of experience designing or operating agent-based systems with explicit control boundaries.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of designing or operating agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to agents or autonomous tooling only in broad or aspirational terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience building agentic tooling or pipelines, but with limited architectural detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains the division between agents and controlling services, including boundaries, contracts, permissions, or auditability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end design of production agentic systems with deliberate autonomy, constraint mechanisms, observability, and operational ownership."}]},{"name":"AI rigor","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant has built AI or LLM functionality in production with attention to reliability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of hands-on AI or LLM work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI in broad terms without clear production use or responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct work on AI or LLM features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects AI work to reliability practices such as evaluation, trustworthiness, guardrails, or failure-mode handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial applied AI experience with explicit operational rigor and a strong connection to trustworthy automation."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates practical skill with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little or no concrete evidence of skill with data structures or algorithms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a general claim of technical strength, but without a specific algorithmic example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports the claim with one concrete example of an algorithm or data-structure improvement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a significant algorithmic redesign that improved speed, scale, correctness, or tractability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Establishes algorithms as a clear strength through technically specific, high-impact examples that influence broader system design."}]},{"name":"Security credibility","description":"Strength of external evidence of security skill or sustained adversarial practice beyond ordinary job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no external evidence of security practice beyond ordinary job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows limited extra security signal, such as casual interest or light ongoing practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one meaningful external signal, such as a recognized baseline certification or recurring CTF participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong external validation through a demanding hands-on certification or consistently strong competitive results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple high-signal forms of external security practice or validation, indicating sustained and serious adversarial skill development."}]},{"name":"Self-directed initiative","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant pursues substantial technical growth beyond assigned work through projects or contributions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little evidence of sustained technical effort beyond assigned work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small or lightly described side effort that shows curiosity but limited rigor."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows one clear self-directed activity, such as a side project, upstream fixes, or regular technical practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial initiative through ambitious personal builds, meaningful open-source work, or sustained external contributions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven growth through technically rigorous projects or widely used contributions maintained to production standards."}]},{"name":"Substantiation","description":"How consistently the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, technical details, outcomes, or scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims and positive adjectives, with few concrete details."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specifics, but many important claims remain largely unsubstantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several major claims with concrete examples, technologies, or project descriptions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently backs claims with specific actions, architecture choices, system types, scope, or outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes nearly every important claim concrete through detailed examples, observable results, quantification, or precise technical context."}]},{"name":"Coherence","description":"How logically and smoothly the letter is structured as an argument for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as choppy, list-like, or weakly sequenced, making the argument harder to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Is understandable overall, but has uneven flow or abrupt shifts between points."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a clear overall structure with a sensible progression of background, evidence, and close."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds the case smoothly, grouping related points well and moving logically from motivation to proof."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels tightly composed, with each paragraph advancing the argument and the whole letter unfolding with strong internal logic."}]},{"name":"Mechanics","description":"Quality of spelling, grammar, and surface correctness.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or usage errors that noticeably distract and weaken credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains repeated mechanical errors or awkward phrasing, though the intended meaning stays clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has occasional minor errors or rough spots that do not materially disrupt reading."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mostly clean and polished, with only minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is polished and mechanically precise, with essentially no distracting errors."}]},{"name":"Voice","description":"How distinctive and engaging the prose feels while remaining professional.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Uses flat or generic language that does little to make the application memorable or convincing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Maintains a professional tone, but feels formulaic or only mildly engaging."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a clear and sincere voice with some persuasive energy."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses confident, distinctive prose that reinforces fit and makes the case engaging."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a highly memorable, authentic voice that strengthens the application without losing professionalism or clarity."}]}]}
